ticket.summary: Dinner-plate-sized damp yellow patch on bedroom ceiling in Apt 5C, stable 3 days, directly below upstairs neighbor's bathroom; neighbor reports no visible leak - needs leak trace.
mitigation_advice: Keep clear of the area and do not touch it if the ceiling starts to bulge or sag [PB-08]

quote_lines.description: Diagnostic visit / camera inspection to trace ceiling leak source

ticket.customer_message: You're booked: Tue Sep 1, 10:30am at 230 Quarry Rd, Apt 5C. And yes - a heads-up to your neighbor is a great idea; access to their bathroom often cuts the diagnosis time in half. If the patch starts dripping or sagging before then, stay clear of it [PB-08] and text us right away.
